name: Android Developer Verification (Google)
description: Google's identity-verification program requiring all Android app developers, including those distributing outside the Play Store, to submit legal name, address, contact details, and potentially government-issued ID before their apps can be installed on certified Android devices. Enforcement begins September 30, 2026 in Brazil, Indonesia, Singapore, and Thailand, with global rollout planned for 2027.
notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date; included as a newly significant global identity-verification requirement affecting all Android app developers rather than end consumers.

name: Bitnob
description: Nigeria-headquartered (Lagos) cryptocurrency and Bitcoin-focused fintech platform requiring KYC identity verification for customer onboarding across African markets.
notes: Not a dedicated identity-verification vendor; included because it directly stored and exposed customer KYC documents via a misconfigured cloud storage bucket.

name: Betty Gaming (Betty.ca)
description: Ontario-licensed online casino and sports-betting operator (Betty.ca) required to verify player age and identity as a condition of its Canadian gambling licence.
notes: Not a dedicated identity-verification vendor; included because a defect in its own age-verification and player-eligibility controls, rather than an external hack, allowed underage individuals to open and fund real-money gambling accounts.
